scope: Independent read-only review of root-authored TransactionEventBounds. Reviewer authored NestedEventArgs/Cert/Extract dependencies; not an independent review of those authored dependencies.
checks: Compared creation and message request fields directly with pinned Upsilon lines832 onward and RefundAccounting.Context.provisional: same original child fuel, checkpoint for both worlds, empty created set, sender/source/origin, access-list entry substate, intrinsic-adjusted gas, actual effective price, transferred/apparent value, data, zero depth, header and permission. Creation salt is none and message code selection is toExecute on checkpoint.
request_gas is a definitional projection for both selected request variants; it adds no funding, gas-fit or aggregate hypothesis.

provisional_residual destructs the actual provisional outcome. Its success Boolean is unrestricted, and the raw child error branches are impossible under provisional.ok. It identifies the real returned gas, not the error-residual convention.

result_inversion is attached to literal Context.result = Upsilon and preserves actual final substate and status through world cleanup. The same provisional witness supplies residual to event accounting and refund settlement.

transaction_events extracts the actual request tree and derives 919*tree.count <= gasLimit - remaining internally from the certified budget, provisional residual identity and entryGas_le_limit. No supplied aggregate hcharged premise remains in the final theorem.

TransactionGas.count_le_used applies the exact Upsilon netGas formula with min(gross/5, refundBalance); remaining<=entry<=limit and refund arithmetic establish all natural/word fits. No artificial no-wrap assumption, gas-validation assumption or refund-balance cap premise is introduced.
Final used is the actual UInt256 reported by Upsilon. Both transaction status values are covered; nested events before rolled-back journals remain in the tree.
Nodup and tree uniqueness are retained for this same actual request and original fuel. No independently chosen trace is substituted.
scope_limits: The theorem counts all qualifying executed LOG0 instructions of length at least68, a conservative superset of audited append events; it does not identify canonical predeploy calls or persistent records.
It applies to completed pinned Upsilon outcomes (Except.ok, including status=false), not top-level interpreter exceptions. Nested exceptions remain represented.

RefundAccounting.Context does not assert Ethereum transaction validation, sender authorization/funding, admission, block association or gas-limit scheduling. Those are not derived from a completed evaluator result.
Distinct successful append-frame injection into the same tree and block/history aggregation remain separate obligations.
commit_binding: Pending parent final exact-source integration/validation commit; bound here by source SHA256 and inspected compile log.
